verdict.rationale: Postman documents Agent Mode, a built-in assistant that takes natural-language instructions to send requests, fix errors, update tests, visualize responses and write documentation across the API lifecycle. Postbot is a second in-app AI assistant, free to try but capped at 50 activities per user per month, with fuller use via a purchasable add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Mode's delegation quality, and in-depth docs on autonomy and scope; Postbot's usage caps and paid add-on are also limitations.
